name: North Atlantic right whale (deep learning)
description:
Deep learning detector for North Atlantic right whale upcalls, using the model of Shiu et al. (2020). Adds Sound Acquisition, an FFT engine, the Deep Learning Classifier, a time display and database and binary storage. Detectors run at 2 kHz, so higher sample rate recordings are decimated automatically.

Note that the deep learning model itself is not shipped with PAMGuard. Open the Deep Learning Classifier settings and either download the built-in 'North Atlantic right whale' default model or browse to your own copy.
author: PAMGuard
